title: VTC: a structured call invite carried in MIMI content
description: From mimid work 2026-11-21 (Mark: file it). mimi-content-10 §5.10 carries only a join URL as an ExternalPart with disposition session; no call id, ring vs room, start time, or call-ended. draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00 has VTCCall; define a media type (e.g. application/vnd.jmap-vtc-call+json or CBOR) for a VTCCall invite inside a mimi-content part, so any MIMI client can show 'Join call' with details and E2EE state.
